subject: QuantaPay x Redwood — POC plan + conditional case study / reference terms
body:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantapay.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantapay.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, May 24, 2025 at 10:06 AM PDT
Subject: QuantaPay x Redwood — POC plan + conditional case study / reference terms

Maya, Elena — thanks again for the time this week. As promised, here’s a crisp POC plan + the (lightweight) terms we discussed around a case study + references.

POC goal (what we’re proving)
- Dedicated capacity can meet QuantaPay’s predictable latency + throughput needs under your traffic shape.
- Redwood Console dashboards + rollout/fallback policies are sufficient for production operations.

Proposed scope (2–3 weeks)
1) Benchmark window + workload definition (Week 1)
   - You provide: representative prompt distribution + expected output lengths + concurrency target
   - We provide: Dedicated pool + model/version pin + routing policy (primary + fallback)
2) Traffic replay / load test (Week 2)
   - Run replay against Dedicated endpoint + capture p50/p95 latency, error rate, throughput, and cost/token
3) Hardening + sign-off (Week 3)
   - Tune batching/limits, validate burst behavior, confirm operational runbook

Success criteria (draft — please edit)
- Latency: p95 within your agreed SLO during steady-state (we’ll define exact number in the plan)
- Reliability: no sustained error-rate spikes; we document any incidents + mitigations
- Predictability: stable latency under target concurrency with no “surprise” throttling

Conditional case study + reference participation (the ask)
If the POC hits the agreed success criteria above, would QuantaPay be open to:
A) 1 public case study (web + PDF) with quantified outcomes (e.g., “reduced p95 latency by X%” / “improved cost per 1K tokens by Y%”), and
B) up to 1–2 reference calls per quarter (scheduled, with a prep doc so your team isn’t surprised)

Two specifics to confirm:
1) Who would be the named spokesperson for quotes (name + title)?
2) Any hard boundaries on what we can publish (e.g., numbers only in ranges, no architecture diagram, etc.)?

Attaching:
- QuantaPay_Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf
- QuantaPay_POC_Benchmarking_Plan_Redwood_v1.docx

If helpful, I can also drop this into a one-page mutual action plan doc we both track (owner + dates).

Thanks,
Priyom

Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference


---

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantapay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantapay.com>, Derek Chen <derek.chen@quantapay.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, May 24, 2025 at 2:31 PM PDT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay x Redwood — POC plan + conditional case study / reference terms

Priyom — this looks directionally good.

On the conditional case study / references:
- Yes, assuming we hit the agreed criteria.
- We can do a public case study, but we’ll need final copy approval from Legal + Comms.
- Preference: use % improvements and avoid publishing absolute $ amounts.
- Architecture: high-level diagram is OK as long as we avoid vendor names that our Sec team flags.

Spokesperson:
- Tentative: Ravi Sethi (VP Engineering). I can be the technical counterpart for interviews.

For the POC criteria, can you propose the exact measurement window (e.g., 60 min sustained run) and how you want to handle outliers/timeouts in the p95 calculation?

Maya


---

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantapay.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantapay.com>, Derek Chen <derek.chen@quantapay.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, May 25, 2025 at 9:18 AM PDT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay x Redwood — POC plan + conditional case study / reference terms

Maya — perfect, thank you.

Re: spokesperson: Ravi Sethi works. If you can confirm his preferred title spelling + whether he’s comfortable being named publicly (logo + quote), we’ll align our side.

Measurement window proposal (edit as needed):
- Primary benchmark: 60 minutes sustained run at target concurrency
- Warm-up: first 10 minutes excluded
- Metric reporting:
  - Latency: p50/p95 across successful requests in the sustained window
  - Timeouts/5xx: reported separately as error rate; we’ll include them in the narrative (no sweeping under the rug)
  - 429s: should be zero in the sustained window; if any show up we treat as a P0 config issue and fix before final numbers

Also aligned on publishing: % improvements only, no absolute spend.

Next steps (Mutual Action Plan quick version):
- QuantaPay (Maya): send representative prompt/output distribution + target concurrency (by Tue 5/27)
- Redwood (Markus): propose initial Dedicated sizing + model/version pin + fallback policy (by Wed 5/28)
- Redwood/QuantaPay: schedule traffic replay run (target Thu/Fri 5/29–5/30)
- If success criteria met: kick off case study interview (week of 6/2) + draft approval workflow

If you’re good with that plan, I’ll send a calendar hold for a 30-min “POC kickoff + measurement agreement” with you + Markus.

Priyom

From: Derek Chen <derek.chen@quantapay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantapay.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantapay.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, May 26, 2025 at 11:04 AM PDT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay x Redwood — POC plan + conditional case study / reference terms

Priyom,

Looping in on the case study portion.

Before we commit to logo/quote usage, can you confirm:
1) Whether participation is covered by our existing NDA (Redwood–QuantaPay NDA dated Feb 3) and how you handle quote approvals
2) Data retention for any benchmark logs you collect (duration + who has access)
3) Whether we can withdraw approval later if circumstances change (e.g., policy changes)

Thanks,
Derek

Derek Chen
Procurement & Vendor Management
QuantaPay


---

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Derek Chen <derek.chen@quantapay.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@quantapay.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantapay.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, May 27, 2025 at 8:42 AM PDT
Subject: Re: QuantaPay x Redwood — POC plan + conditional case study / reference terms

Derek — great questions.

1) NDA + approvals
- Yes, we can operate under the existing NDA for the POC.
- For public marketing (logo/quotes), we do a separate, explicit written approval step on final copy + final quotes. Nothing goes live without that sign-off.

2) Data retention / access (for benchmark artifacts)
- For the benchmark, we primarily need aggregate metrics (latency percentiles, error rates, throughput) and configuration notes.
- Any request logs we retain are limited to what’s necessary for troubleshooting/measurement; we can align on a specific retention window during kickoff.
- Access is restricted to the Redwood team supporting the POC (AE + Solutions Engineering). We can document the owners in the mutual action plan.

3) Withdrawal clause
- Yes — we can include a withdrawal/removal clause for the case study asset if your policy changes. (We’ll reflect this in the release language once we’re at that step.)

If helpful, Markus and I can cover these in 5 minutes at the POC kickoff and document the agreed retention + approval flow in the plan.

Priyom

Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus@redwoodinference.com | priyom@redwoodinference.com
